# Build the resume PDF

Owner: resume-tailor (resume-editor may run it read-only into a scratch folder to reproduce).
Tier: T1. Renderer: `scripts/render_resume.py` (RenderCV 2.8; LaTeX fallback). Every variant renders
with the general base's design: its copies `V/template-classic.yaml` (the resume) and
`V/template-inline.yaml` (the inline-dates copy), at `--density one-page`; T below means
`--template V/template-classic.yaml --density one-page`. The house template
(`resumes/templates/rendercv-ats.yaml`) is the default only for a resume that is not a variant of the
base. Never hand-edit a PDF, `meta.yaml` or a template from here.

## Procedure
1. Work from the user's data folder (`$JAJA_DATA`); V = the resume folder.
2. Lint first: `python3 scripts/render_resume.py lint --input V/resume.yaml T`.
   Fix by code: `missing-evidence` / `unknown-evidence` (add or correct the trailing
   `<!-- ev:... -->`, ids must exist in `profile/evidence.yaml`); `evidence-not-trailing` (move the
   comment to the end); `not-a-string` (quote the bullet); `em-dash` (only when `style.no_em_dash` is set);
   `bullet-too-long` (two lines
   at most at the layout's measured width, unless a NOTE names the owner's ruling); `double-space`,
   `nested-bullet`, `hidden-link` (unless a NOTE names the owner's ruling), `raw-typst`, `table-content`;
   `bad-sidecar`, `unknown-base` (`base_of` must be `general`);
   `noncanonical-heading` (use Education, Skills, Experience, Projects, Publications, Awards, or
   Summary, Certifications); `missing-name`, `missing-email`, `missing-location`, `missing-date`,
   `date-precision` (YYYY-MM), `bad-date`, `bad-evidence-id`. Warnings (`section-order`,
   `en-dash-in-prose`, `duplicate-bullet`, `stray-comment`) are reported, not ignored. Full list:
   `resumes/templates/README.md`.
3. Render: `python3 scripts/render_resume.py render --input V/resume.yaml --out V T --basename <Name>_Resume`
   (without it the file is named from the YAML, `<First>_<Last>_Resume.pdf`), then the inline copy
   `python3 scripts/render_resume.py render --input V/resume.yaml --out V/inline --template V/template-inline.yaml --density one-page --basename <Name>_Resume_inline-dates`;
   add `--docx` when the job's `ats_vendor` is `workday` (company line above title in the DOCX);
   `--engine latex` only when RenderCV fails (the LaTeX template carries the PDFKit hardening).
4. Read `V/meta.yaml`: `status: ok`, `pages: 1`, `pdf` (the file name), `template`, `density`, `hash`,
   `evidence_ids`, `pdf_title` ("<Name>, Resume": the lens never shows).
   A "page budget" failure prints "Longest sections:"; cut the lowest-relevance bullets there and
   re-render. `--force` renders despite lint errors for diagnosis only; a forced PDF is never used.
5. Verify the text layer yourself: `pdftotext -layout V/<pdf> - | head -40` shows the name, the
   contact line with the owner's address, and sections in order; when `style.no_em_dash` is set,
   `pdftotext V/<pdf> - | grep -c "—"` prints 0.
6. Layout: `python3 scripts/page_layout_check.py V/<pdf>` and `python3 scripts/page_layout_check.py V/inline/<pdf>`
   exit 0 (each writes `page-1.png` and `layout-report.json` beside its PDF; apply_pack.py refuses a page without a
   PASS for that exact PDF). For the base use `--out resumes/bases/general/layout/classic` (and `.../inline` for the
   inline-dates PDF): its two PDFs share one folder. Read `V/page-1.png` yourself: text checks alone miss a badly
   spaced page. A FAIL names the defect (the page
   stops short: fill it with the strongest true work; headers crowded: renderer spacing, the RESUME lane's).
7. Run `ats-check` next; a PDF is not usable until both pass.

## Output
`V/<pdf>`, `V/meta.yaml`, optional DOCX; reply with pages, status, hash, lint warnings.

Exit codes (both scripts): 0 ok, 1 content failure, 2 usage error, 3 toolchain failure (render).

## Stop conditions
Lint errors you cannot fix without inventing content; exit 3 from both RenderCV and LaTeX (report
the stderr tail to the Recruiter: an engineering issue).

## Worked example
First render of an agentic-systems variant fails: "page budget: 2 pages. Longest sections:
Experience, Projects". The newest Experience entry has 6 bullets (r = 3, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1) and Projects 2.
Cut the r = 1 bullet and the second project; re-render: `status: ok`, `pages: 1`;
`pdftotext` shows the contact line intact.
